kb-update (15:20Z cycle, degraded DD-scan-diff): added false alarm fa-2026-11-27-watchdog-approutine-subscriber-amqp-publish-latency-story to kb/false-alarms.json.

Monitor 236570583 ('New issue to review') fired at 14:19:03Z on Watchdog story e71a751e: 'Latency increased on the basic.publish EntityIntegrationEvent resource in approutine-subscriber'. The p95 of trace.amqp.command for that resource went from 0.06-0.094ms to a 0.157ms peak at 14:15Z, which is sub-millisecond. It happened during a low-traffic trough (260-363 publishes per 15 min vs 4k-73k earlier), and the same 14:00Z trough shows on 11-26. There were 0 amqp errors and 0 approutine-subscriber error logs from 13:30 to 15:15Z. The entry is keyed on the story title, not the bare monitor id.

This is the 2nd sub-ms Watchdog latency story to page alert-system this week (after the sync-xero heartbeat one on 11-20). A latency floor on 236570583 would cut this noise.

Evidence: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.amqp.command&exp_scope=env%3Aprod%2Cservice%3Aapproutine-subscriber%2Cresource_name%3Abasic.publish_entityintegrationevent_-_all&exp_agg=avg&start=1795773600&end=1795792500
Report: docs/investigations/2026-11-27-1f70401d2246aad9.md
